test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Aarush starts walking 9 m towards the north, then turns left and walks 17 m. He again turns left to walk 9 m. In which direction is he facing now? (All tums are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
According to the given information:

Aarush walks 9 meters north. At this point, he is facing north.

He turns left (to the west) and walks 17 meters. Now he is facing west.

He turns left again (to the south) and walks 9 meters.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/560c163e090cfdd2f4d14dbf054504c23addba2c368ad3fcc7f7ee359995381f.png] 

So, he is facing **South **now.

Hence, the correct answer is** "South".**
